summary.description: The manufacturer specification identifies EVE-30P/INR18650-30P as a 3000mAh nominal 18650 lithium-ion cell. The exact EVE 30P is sold for replaceable 18650 vaporizer and vape-starter-kit use; independent testing supports a 20A comparison value. The cell is an unprotected OEM cell; warnings require protected-pack/device safeguards. This record preserves exact-model evidence and unresolved revision caveats for the canonical catalog entry.

claims.statement: The exact product identity is EVE INR18650/30P (INR18650/30P), as named by the product source and exact-model test.
The manufacturer specification identifies EVE-30P/INR18650-30P as a 3000mAh nominal 18650 lithium-ion cell.

The exact-model Battery Mooch test is identified as a 30A 3000mAh EVE 30P test; current application guidance in specialist-vape retail pages attributes a conservative 20A continuous comparison value to independent testing.
The exact EVE INR18650/30P has an exact-model Battery Mooch test and current specialist-vape retail coverage.
The current 76-entry Steam Engine battery catalog contains no exact EVE INR18650/30P identity.

A current Fogg Father listing labels the EVE 30P manufacturer as Sony even though the model identity and manufacturer documentation identify EVE Energy; this is retained as an unresolved retailer metadata conflict.
Fogg Father listed one EVE 30P cell at £7.99 in the UK on 2026-08-04.
